outcome: Standard plasma coagulation tests (PT, APTT, fibrinogen, factor levels, thrombin generation)
cohort: The study included 116 very premature infants with gestational age less than 30 weeks, and term neonates served as controls for coagulation test comparisons.
finding: Typical ranges for standard coagulation tests in very preterm infants were determined, and despite longer clotting times, thrombin generation was similar in very preterm and term infants.
followup_time: Until 30 weeks corrected gestational age (for preterm infants)
cross-section timing: Samples were collected at birth, on days 1 and 3, and fortnightly thereafter; primary cross-sectional data for comparison was reported for Day 1.
